concepts.name: Elementary stream operations
concepts.gloss: Splitting an array into streams by a digit or by cyclic rows, applying a pointwise map, and merging, all in O(V) tape steps.

concepts.name: Cyclic convolution
concepts.gloss: The product of two coefficient lists as polynomials modulo x^S−1, so entries sum over index pairs adding to a fixed value modulo S; also done on products of several cyclic axes.

concepts.gloss: The normalized transform F_q taking u to averages of u_j times roots of unity, which turns convolution into pointwise product.

concepts.gloss: Nested nondegenerate subspaces built from three-element subsets of a fixed set, attached to gates so each edge's frame change costs its residual dimension.

concepts.name: Power-width chunk interchange
concepts.gloss: Recursively interchanging two address chunks of m^k digits by running the bit network on W role streams, with cost recurrence F_k ≤ (s/W)F_{k−1}+O(1).

concepts.name: Fast interchange of address chunks
concepts.gloss: Swapping two disjoint address chunks of u bits in O(V u^τ) tape time for a fixed τ<1, by padding to power widths and base-m pieces.

symbols.name: bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored data bits in the array.

symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each interchanged chunk.

symbols.name: exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed rational constant below 1, namely 1−2^{-50}.

concepts.name: Packed selected-bit addition
concepts.gloss: XORing corresponding selected bits of two address chunks at once, using a third chunk as restored scratch, with exceptional addresses repaired by sorting.

concepts.name: Polynomial ring modulo y^r+1
concepts.gloss: Complex polynomials of degree below r with y^r=−1, where multiplying by a power of y is a signed shift of coefficients and serves as a root of unity.
concepts.title: Polynomial ring modulo $y^r+1$

symbols.name: indeterminate
symbols.meaning: The polynomial variable, whose powers act as roots of unity.

symbols.name: record length
symbols.meaning: The number of complex coefficients in a record, a power of two.

concepts.name: Synthetic polynomial transform
concepts.gloss: The transform F_t with root ω_t=y^{2r/t} in the ring modulo y^r+1, a contraction whose root multiplications are signed shifts.

concepts.name: Simultaneous butterfly layer
concepts.gloss: Applying H0 to the same bit of up to d address chunks at once, using the phase network and packed bit additions, at cost O(V d^λ′) with one final truncation.
concepts.title: Simultaneous butterfly layer in $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$

symbols.name: bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of stored data bits.

symbols.name: axis count
symbols.meaning: The maximum number of axes whose chunks are transformed together.

concepts.name: Transform layout and cost
concepts.gloss: Placing selected bits of all axes at a common offset in consecutive chunks so butterfly layers apply round by round, and bounding the whole synthetic transform.

concepts.name: Signed packing for ring products
concepts.gloss: Kronecker substitution evaluating polynomial coefficients at a power of two to multiply ring elements with an ordinary O(N log N) integer multiplier.

concepts.name: Convolution from retained transform layout
concepts.gloss: Convolution over the ring: two forward synthetic transforms, pointwise ring products, and the opposite transform, keeping the same frequency order throughout.

concepts.name: Chinese-remainder address map
concepts.gloss: An isomorphism of cyclic convolution on S=∏s_i points onto a product of pairwise coprime cyclic axes, implemented by triangular controlled shifts.

evidence.quote: Agarwal and Cooley used the Chinese remainder

concepts.name: Fixed-point error control
concepts.gloss: Complex values on a grid of spacing 2^{-p} in the unit disk, linear contractions that do not enlarge error, truncation, and additive error bookkeeping.

concepts.name: Gaussian resampling
concepts.gloss: Gaussian-weighted contractions A and B0 that relate a Fourier transform of length s to one of length t slightly larger, with the two coordinate permutations kept inside the identity.

concepts.name: Multidimensional resampling
concepts.gloss: The tensor product of the one-dimensional resampling identities over d axes, applied one line at a time, with axis movement done by chunk interchange.

concepts.name: Bluestein chirp and permutation cancellation
concepts.gloss: A chirp identity turns the permuted middle transform into a cyclic convolution with pointwise phases, and the source permutation cancels between forward transforms and the opposite one.

concepts.name: Coefficient phase twist
concepts.gloss: Mapping x_d to ζy, ζ=e^{πi/r}, turns cyclic wrap of the last axis into the negative wrap of the ring modulo y^r+1.

concepts.name: Parameter choices and cost table
concepts.gloss: Choice p=6b, d≈b^ε, K≈d^c and the rational exponents, with a cost table whose every normalized term is at most p^{1−2κ}.

concepts.gloss: A deterministic fixed-tape machine multiplies n-bit integers by digit convolution, CRT axes, resampling, chirps, twisting, synthetic convolution and rounding, disproving the n log n conjecture.
